# Why Minimum Volume Requirements Lock Out Small Businesses


November 13, 2026


[Shashank Yadav](https://salarybox.in/blog/author/shashank87cc9f270b/)


[No comments yet](https://salarybox.in/blog/why-minimum-volume-requirements-lock-out-small-businesses/#respond)


Most background verification companies in India are built for large enterprises. AuthBridge, First Advantage, and HireRight all require annual contracts, minimum verification volumes, and multi-week onboarding processes before you can run a single check.


This model works for a company hiring 500 employees a year. It does not work for a 30-person logistics firm that hires 3 drivers a month, or a 15-person startup that brings on 1-2 engineers per quarter.


The numbers paint a clear picture of why small businesses cannot afford to skip verification:


- AuthBridge’s H1 FY26 data shows a **4.33% discrepancy rate** across white-collar hires in India
- Their H2 2025 report found **18.8% of candidates misrepresented** at least one credential
- EY India discovered that **32% of flagged candidates had listed employers that did not exist** in any government record
- OnGrid’s FY 2024-25 report recorded **3.6 lakh BGV failures** across their platform


Small businesses face the same fraud risks as enterprises but cannot access the same tools. A minimum-volume contract of 50-100 verifications per month at Rs. 1,500-3,000 per candidate means Rs. 75,000 to Rs. 3,00,000 per month — whether you use them or not.


This blog reviews **8 background check tools that have no minimum volume requirements** , so you can verify 1 candidate or 100 candidates without a contract, a sales call, or a wasted budget.


**What you will find in this blog:**


- A side-by-side comparison table of all 8 tools
- Detailed review of each tool’s pricing, checks, and small-business fit
- A feature matrix comparing all 8 across 10 key dimensions
- The hidden costs of minimum volume contracts explained
- A decision framework based on your team size and hiring pattern
- 10 FAQs answered

### 2. SpringVerify — Self-Serve BGV Platform for Funded Startups


**Pricing:** Rs. 799-1,599 per candidate (depending on package; Basic, Standard, Premium tiers)


**Minimum Volume:** None — pay per candidate with no contract


**Checks Covered:** PAN, Voter ID, Driving Licence, UAN/EPFO, criminal records (court database), education verification, address verification, reference checks


**Strengths:**


- **Widest check coverage without a contract:** SpringVerify covers identity, employment, criminal, education, and address checks — all available without minimum volumes. This is the broadest check portfolio among no-minimum tools.
- **Self-serve dashboard:** HR managers can sign up, add candidates, and track verification progress through a clean web dashboard without calling sales.
- **ATS integration:** Integrates with popular ATS platforms (Zoho Recruit, Freshteam, Lever) so verification can be triggered directly from your hiring workflow.
- **Candidate-initiated flow:** Send the candidate a link to upload their own documents. Reduces HR workload for document collection.


**Limitations:**


- **Higher cost than SalaryBox Verify:** The Basic plan at Rs. 799 covers fewer checks than what SalaryBox Verify includes at Rs. 499. For full coverage (criminal + education), you need the Rs. 1,599 Premium plan — 3.2x the cost of SalaryBox Verify.
- **Not instant:** Criminal and education checks take 24-72 hours because they involve manual verification with courts and universities. Only identity checks are near-instant.
- **No UAN/EPFO depth:** While SpringVerify covers employment verification, it primarily relies on reference calls to previous employers rather than direct EPFO database queries. A candidate who provides a fake reference number can still pass.
- **Funded startup pricing model:** SpringVerify’s pricing makes sense for VC-backed startups with hiring budgets. A bootstrapped small business verifying 5 hires/month at Rs. 1,599 each spends Rs. 7,995/month vs. Rs. 2,495 with SalaryBox Verify.


**Best for:** Funded startups (Series A+) that need criminal and education checks alongside identity verification, and have the budget for Rs. 799-1,599 per candidate.


**Verdict:** SpringVerify is the best choice for small businesses that specifically need criminal record and education verification. For identity and employment verification alone, SalaryBox Verify delivers instant results at 38-69% lower cost.


### 3. OnGrid — Pay-Per-Check Verification for Growing Teams


**Pricing:** Rs. 250-500 per individual check (pricing varies by check type; identity checks cheaper than employment/criminal checks)


**Minimum Volume:** None — pay per check with no annual commitment


**Checks Covered:** PAN, Driving Licence, Voter ID, UAN/EPFO employment history, criminal records, education verification, address verification, court record checks


**Strengths:**


- **Granular per-check pricing:** Unlike bundled pricing (where you pay for all checks regardless of what you need), OnGrid lets you select and pay for individual checks. Need only PAN and EPFO? Pay for just those two.
- **Strong EPFO/UAN expertise:** OnGrid is known for their UAN-based employment verification. Their FY 2024-25 report documented 3.6 lakh BGV failures, demonstrating the scale and depth of their employment verification capabilities.
- **Court record coverage:** Access to district and high court records for criminal background checks — a check type that most no-minimum tools cannot offer.
- **API and dashboard options:** Available as both a web dashboard for manual checks and APIs for integration into HR tech stacks.


**Limitations:**


- **Per-check costs add up quickly:** While individual checks are cheap (Rs. 250 each), running PAN + Voter ID + DL + EPFO for one candidate costs Rs. 1,000-2,000 at per-check rates. SalaryBox Verify bundles all four for Rs. 499.
- **Semi-self-serve:** While OnGrid does not require minimum volumes, initial onboarding may involve a brief sales conversation to set up your account. Not as instant as SalaryBox Verify’s sign-up-and-go model.
- **Variable turnaround:** Identity checks return quickly (minutes to hours), but employment and criminal checks can take 24-72 hours depending on the verification type and volume.
- **Pricing not fully transparent online:** Exact per-check rates are not always published on their website. You may need to request a quote for certain check types.


**Best for:** Growing SMBs (20-200 employees) that need the flexibility to run different check types for different roles — identity checks for all hires, criminal checks only for sensitive roles — without paying for a full bundle every time.


**Verdict:** OnGrid is a solid choice for businesses that need granular, per-check pricing and strong EPFO expertise. However, for small businesses that consistently need PAN + Voter ID + DL + EPFO for every hire, SalaryBox Verify’s Rs. 499 bundle is 50-75% cheaper than running the same checks individually on OnGrid.


### 4. HelloVerify — Gig and Blue-Collar Verification Without Contracts


**Pricing:** Rs. 150-400 per check (varies by check type; basic identity checks starting at Rs. 150, comprehensive packages up to Rs. 400)


**Minimum Volume:** None — designed for businesses with variable, unpredictable hiring volumes


**Checks Covered:** PAN, Voter ID, Driving Licence, address verification (field visits), criminal record checks, court checks, reference checks


**Strengths:**


- **Built for gig and blue-collar hiring:** HelloVerify specialises in verifying delivery drivers, domestic workers, security guards, and contract labourers — the roles most small businesses hire for but enterprise BGV tools overlook.
- **Lowest per-check pricing:** Basic identity checks start at Rs. 150 — the lowest per-check price on this list. For businesses that only need one or two check types per hire, this is extremely cost-effective.
- **Field address verification:** HelloVerify offers physical address visits through their field agent network — something most digital-only tools (including SalaryBox Verify and SurePass) cannot do.
- **Y Combinator backed:** HelloVerify was part of the Y Combinator batch, giving it credibility and access to enterprise-grade infrastructure despite its SMB focus.


**Limitations:**


- **Limited EPFO/UAN coverage:** HelloVerify’s strength is identity and address verification, not employment history. UAN/EPFO-based employment checks are either limited or unavailable in their standard packages. For catching fake employers and moonlighting, SalaryBox Verify’s EPFO check is more reliable.
- **Semi-self-serve onboarding:** While no minimum volumes are required, some package configurations may involve a brief sales conversation. Not as instant as SalaryBox Verify’s browser-based signup.
- **Gig-focused feature set:** HelloVerify’s dashboard and reporting are optimised for high-volume, low-complexity checks (identity + address for delivery drivers). For white-collar hiring that needs cross-referenced PAN + EPFO + DL checks, the platform feels less polished.
- **Variable turnaround for field checks:** Digital identity checks return in hours, but physical address verification through field agents can take 2-5 business days.


**Best for:** Logistics companies, food delivery services, facility management firms, and staffing agencies that hire gig workers, delivery drivers, and blue-collar staff in bulk without minimum volume commitments.


**Verdict:** HelloVerify is the best choice for blue-collar and gig-worker verification, especially when physical address verification is required. For white-collar identity and employment verification, SalaryBox Verify offers a more comprehensive check set (PAN + Voter ID + DL + UAN/EPFO) at a predictable Rs. 499 flat rate with instant results.


### 5. DigiVerifier — AI-Powered Verification for Small HR Teams


**Pricing:** Rs. 399-999 per candidate (tiered packages based on check depth)


**Minimum Volume:** None — pay per candidate without contracts


**Checks Covered:** PAN, UAN/EPFO employment verification, criminal records, education verification, address verification, social media screening, reference checks with AI-assisted analysis


**Strengths:**


- **AI-assisted reference checks:** DigiVerifier uses AI to analyse reference check responses, flagging inconsistencies and scoring credibility. This reduces the time HR teams spend manually evaluating references.
- **Social media screening:** Scans public social media profiles for red flags — an increasingly important check for client-facing and brand-sensitive roles that most BGV tools do not offer.
- **Candidate-friendly workflow:** Candidates receive a link to upload documents and complete consent digitally. Reduces back-and-forth between HR and candidates.
- **Self-serve signup:** HR managers can create an account and start verifying without a sales call or demo, similar to SalaryBox Verify’s approach.


**Limitations:**


- **Higher cost for basic checks:** At Rs. 399 for the basic package, DigiVerifier costs less than SpringVerify but more than SalaryBox Verify (Rs. 499 for all government database checks). For businesses that only need identity and employment verification, SalaryBox Verify is the more cost-effective choice.
- **Limited Voter ID and DL coverage:** DigiVerifier’s primary focus is on PAN, EPFO, criminal, and education checks. Voter ID and Driving Licence verification may not be available in standard packages or may have limited depth compared to SalaryBox Verify’s direct government database queries.
- **AI features require trust:** AI-powered reference analysis and social media screening are innovative but may flag false positives. Small businesses without dedicated HR may lack the context to evaluate AI-generated red flags.
- **Turnaround for non-digital checks:** Identity checks return in hours, but criminal records, education verification, and reference checks take 24-48 hours.


**Best for:** Small businesses (10-100 employees) with dedicated HR personnel who value AI-assisted analysis and social media screening alongside standard identity and employment verification.


**Verdict:** DigiVerifier adds AI-powered reference checks and social media screening that no other tool on this list offers. However, for straightforward government database verification (PAN + Voter ID + DL + EPFO), SalaryBox Verify is faster (instant vs. 24-48 hours), cheaper (Rs. 499 vs. Rs. 399-999), and covers more ID types.


### 6. SurePass — Government Database APIs With Pay-As-You-Go Pricing


**Pricing:** Rs. 1-5 per API call (volume-based tiers; free sandbox for testing)


**Minimum Volume:** None — true pay-per-call pricing with no commitments


**Checks Covered:** PAN, Voter ID, Driving Licence, UAN/EPFO, Aadhaar (via OKYC), GST, RC (vehicle registration), bank account verification, passport, MCA (company verification), and 100+ additional government databases


**Strengths:**


- **Widest database coverage:** SurePass offers API access to over 100 government and institutional databases — more than any other tool on this list. If a government database exists in digital form, SurePass likely has an API for it.
- **True pay-per-call pricing:** No subscriptions, no credits, no minimum volume. You pay only for the exact API calls you make. At Rs. 1-5 per call, running 4 checks per candidate costs Rs. 4-20 in API fees alone.
- **Free sandbox:** Test your integration with dummy data before going live. No charges for sandbox API calls.
- **Instant responses:** API calls return results in 1-5 seconds per query — the fastest turnaround on this list alongside SalaryBox Verify.


**Limitations:**


- **Developer-only tool:** SurePass is an API platform, not an HR tool. There is no web dashboard where an HR manager can enter a candidate’s name and get a report. You need a developer to build the integration, design the workflow, and maintain the system.
- **Hidden total cost:** While API calls are cheap (Rs. 1-5 each), the total cost includes developer time to build the integration (40-80 hours at Rs. 500-2,000/hour = Rs. 20,000-1,60,000), hosting costs for your verification system, and ongoing maintenance. For a small business running 10 checks/month, the per-candidate cost including development amortisation far exceeds SalaryBox Verify’s Rs. 499.
- **No PDF reports:** Returns JSON/XML data. You must build your own reporting layer if you need downloadable verification reports for HR files.
- **No candidate workflow:** Each government database is a separate API endpoint. Your developer must orchestrate the sequence of calls, handle errors, and build the user interface.


**Best for:** Tech startups and SaaS companies with in-house developers who want to build custom verification workflows into their own products, and value the widest possible government database coverage.


**Verdict:** SurePass has the lowest per-check API cost and the widest database coverage. But it is a developer infrastructure tool, not an HR tool. Unless you have engineering resources to build and maintain the integration, SalaryBox Verify’s ready-made workflow at Rs. 499 delivers the same core checks (PAN, Voter ID, DL, EPFO) with zero development cost.


### 7. Compose1 Verify — Lightweight BGV for Early-Stage Companies


**Pricing:** Rs. 299-599 per candidate (Basic and Standard tiers)


**Minimum Volume:** None — designed for companies that are just starting to build a verification process


**Checks Covered:** PAN verification, basic employment history verification, limited identity checks (Voter ID, DL coverage may vary), address verification


**Strengths:**


- **Lowest bundled pricing:** Starting at Rs. 299 per candidate, Compose1 Verify has the lowest bundled per-candidate price among platforms that offer more than just API access. For businesses that need basic checks, this is very affordable.
- **Simple, clean interface:** The platform is designed for non-technical users. No complex dashboards, no overwhelming feature sets — just enter candidate details and get results.
- **Quick onboarding:** Self-serve signup with minimal friction. Designed for companies that have never run background checks before and want to start with a basic process.
- **Good for first-time BGV users:** Compose1 positions itself as the entry point for companies that are moving from zero verification to structured hiring checks.


**Limitations:**


- **Limited check depth:** Compose1 Verify covers basic identity and employment checks but may not offer the full depth of government database queries available on SalaryBox Verify (PAN + Voter ID + DL + UAN/EPFO in one workflow).
- **Narrower government database coverage:** Voter ID and Driving Licence verification may not be available in all packages or may have limited detail compared to platforms that query Parivahan/Sarathi and ECI databases directly.
- **Newer platform:** Compose1 Verify is relatively new compared to established players. The platform is still building out its feature set, and some capabilities that SalaryBox Verify and SpringVerify offer may not yet be available.
- **Limited UAN/EPFO depth:** Employment verification may rely on reference-based methods rather than direct EPFO database queries. For catching fabricated employers, SalaryBox Verify’s EPFO check is more reliable.


**Best for:** Early-stage companies (pre-seed to seed stage) with fewer than 20 employees that need basic background checks for the first time and want the most affordable entry point.


**Verdict:** Compose1 Verify is a good starter tool for companies new to background verification. However, for businesses that want comprehensive government database checks (PAN + Voter ID + DL + EPFO) with instant results and PDF reports, SalaryBox Verify at Rs. 499 offers deeper verification for a marginal price increase over Compose1’s Rs. 299 basic tier.


### 8. DIY Government Portal Checks — Free But Manual Alternative


**Pricing:** Free (no cost for any check)


**Minimum Volume:** Not applicable — government portals are open to everyone


**Checks Covered:** PAN status verification, Voter ID lookup, Driving Licence validity, UAN/EPFO membership details (limited without employee login credentials)


**Strengths:**


- **Zero cost:** Every check is completely free. For solo founders and micro-businesses with extremely tight budgets, this is the most affordable option.
- **Direct government source:** You are querying the exact same databases that paid platforms query. The data is identical.
- **No signup or account needed:** Most government portals allow public verification lookups without creating an account.
- **Full control:** You decide what to check, when to check, and how to document the results.


**Limitations:**


- **Extremely time-consuming:** Each portal has its own interface, login flow, and CAPTCHA requirements. Running PAN + Voter ID + DL + EPFO checks for one candidate takes 20-30 minutes of manual work across 4 different websites. SalaryBox Verify runs all four checks in seconds from a single interface.
- **No cross-referencing:** Government portals show individual results. They do not compare names, dates of birth, or other identity signals across databases. You must manually spot mismatches between PAN and Voter ID records — something SalaryBox Verify does automatically.
- **No PDF reports:** There is no downloadable verification report. You must screenshot results or manually document findings for your HR files. This creates inconsistent records and audit trail gaps.
- **Limited EPFO access:** The EPFO portal requires the employee’s UAN and linked mobile number for full employment history access. Without the candidate’s active cooperation, you can only verify basic UAN membership status — not the full employer-wise contribution history that SalaryBox Verify’s EPFO check reveals.
- **No batch processing:** Each candidate must be verified individually across all four portals. For a business hiring 10 people per month, this means 40+ separate manual verification sessions — 5-8 hours of HR time.
- **Portal downtime:** Government websites frequently experience downtime, slow loading, and CAPTCHA errors. A check that takes 5 minutes when the portal is working can take 30 minutes with retries.


**Best for:** Solo founders and micro-businesses (1-5 employees) with zero budget for verification tools, willing to invest their own time instead of money.


**Verdict:** DIY portal checks are free but enormously time-consuming. A business owner’s time is worth far more than Rs. 499 per candidate. For any business hiring more than 1-2 people per quarter, SalaryBox Verify pays for itself by saving 20-30 minutes of manual work per candidate while delivering automated cross-referencing and PDF reports.

### The Hidden Costs of Minimum Volume Contracts


Before you consider an enterprise BGV provider because of its brand recognition, understand what minimum volume contracts actually cost a small business:


**Scenario: A 40-person retail company hiring 5 employees per month**


Cost Component Enterprise BGV (AuthBridge) No-Minimum Tool (SalaryBox Verify)


**Per-candidate cost** Rs. 2,000-2,500 Rs. 499


**Minimum monthly commitment** 50 candidates (Rs. 1,00,000-1,25,000) None (pay only for 5 candidates: Rs. 2,495)


**Annual contract value** Rs. 12,00,000-15,00,000 Rs. 29,940 (60 hires x Rs. 499)

**What you actually lose with minimum volume contracts:**


**1. Cash flow:** A Rs. 1,00,000/month BGV commitment is significant for a small business with a Rs. 5-15 lakh monthly payroll. That money is locked whether you hire or not.


**2. Flexibility:** Hiring is seasonal for most small businesses. A retail store hires 15 people before Diwali and 2 people in January. A minimum volume contract charges the same both months.


**3. Time:** Enterprise BGV onboarding takes 2-6 weeks. During that time, you are hiring without verification — the exact risk you were trying to eliminate.


**4. Control:** Enterprise contracts include auto-renewal clauses, price escalation terms, and early termination penalties. A small business that wants to switch providers mid-contract may face 3-6 months of exit fees.


**5. Over-verification:** To use up minimum credits, small businesses often run expensive checks (criminal, education, address) on roles that only need identity verification. This wastes budget on checks that do not add value for that role.


**The math is clear:** For any business hiring fewer than 50 people per month, a no-minimum tool like SalaryBox Verify saves 70-97% compared to enterprise BGV contracts.

### FAQs: No-Minimum Background Check Tools for Small Businesses


###### 1. What does “no minimum volume” mean for background check tools?


No minimum volume means you can verify 1 candidate or 100 candidates without any commitment. There is no monthly quota you must hit, no annual contract, and no penalty for low usage. You pay only when you actually run a check. This is critical for small businesses where hiring is irregular — you might hire 5 people one month and zero the next.


###### 2. Which no-minimum background check tool is best for small businesses in India?


SalaryBox Verify is the best overall choice. At Rs. 499 per candidate, it covers PAN, Voter ID, Driving Licence, and UAN/EPFO verification through direct government database queries, with instant results and PDF reports. No other no-minimum tool combines this check depth, speed, and pricing without requiring developer resources.


###### 3. Are no-minimum tools less reliable than enterprise BGV providers?


No. Tools like SalaryBox Verify query the exact same government databases (Income Tax Department, Election Commission, Parivahan, EPFO) that enterprise providers like AuthBridge use for identity checks. The data source is identical. The difference is in the delivery model (self-serve vs. sales-led) and the pricing structure (pay-per-candidate vs. annual contract), not in data quality.


###### 4. Can I use SalaryBox Verify without talking to a salesperson?


Yes. SalaryBox Verify is fully self-serve. Sign up at salarybox.in/verify, enter your candidate’s details, select the checks you need, confirm Rs. 499 billing, and receive results in seconds. There is no sales call, no demo, no contract signing, and no onboarding process. You can run your first verification within 5 minutes.


###### 5. What checks do small businesses actually need for every hire?


For most small business hires, four government database checks cover the essential risks: PAN verification (confirms tax identity), Voter ID verification (confirms address and identity), Driving Licence verification (essential for driving roles, useful as additional ID for all roles), and UAN/EPFO employment history (catches fake employers and moonlighting). SalaryBox Verify bundles all four at Rs. 499.


###### 6. How much do no-minimum background check tools cost compared to enterprise providers?


No-minimum tools range from free (DIY government portals) to Rs. 1,599 per candidate (SpringVerify Premium). SalaryBox Verify sits at Rs. 499 per candidate for all government database checks. Enterprise providers like AuthBridge typically charge Rs. 1,500-3,000+ per candidate with annual contracts and minimum volumes of 50-100 verifications per month.


###### 7. Do I need criminal record checks for every hire?


No. Criminal record checks are important for specific roles: those handling cash or finances, those with access to sensitive data or systems, those working with vulnerable populations (children, elderly, patients), and security or law enforcement roles. For most small business hires (retail staff, marketing, operations, admin), identity and employment verification through SalaryBox Verify is sufficient as a first layer.


###### 8. Can no-minimum tools handle bulk hiring during peak seasons?


Yes. SalaryBox Verify, SpringVerify, and OnGrid all scale with your hiring volume without requiring you to change plans or negotiate new contracts. If you hire 3 people in June and 20 in October (Diwali season), you pay for exactly 3 and 20 respectively. There is no need to pre-commit or adjust your plan.


###### 9. What happens if a no-minimum tool shuts down or changes pricing?


Because there is no contract, you have zero switching costs. If SalaryBox Verify changed its pricing tomorrow, you could move to SpringVerify or OnGrid with the same ease you signed up originally. This is actually an advantage over enterprise contracts, where switching providers mid-contract involves termination fees, data migration, and re-onboarding.


###### 10. Should I use a no-minimum tool even if I plan to grow to 100+ hires per month?


Yes, start with a no-minimum tool now and evaluate enterprise tools later. Many businesses start with SalaryBox Verify at Rs. 499/candidate and only consider enterprise providers when they need check types that self-serve tools do not cover (court records, international checks, physical address visits).
